title: BDLB Tier Explanation
description: Schema for tier_explanation.{tier}.json produced by tier-explanation-enricher. Validates the documentation-grounded explanation payload for a single lesson tier (easy/medium/hard).

tier.description: Which lesson tier this explanation covers.

tier_spec_ref.description: Path to the tier_spec.{tier}.json file this explanation enriches.

thinking_steps.description: Ordered sequence of cognitive steps a student should follow to solve a tier-level item.

why_students_make_it.description: Cognitive/curricular reason students fall into this trap.

correction.description: How to address or correct the misconception.

common_misconceptions.description: Documented misconceptions students commonly hold at this tier.

var_id_reference.description: Optional reference to a specific variation_matrix var_id this example illustrates. May be null if not yet bound to a variation.

final_answer.description: Final answer for the worked example.

worked_example.description: A fully worked example, grounded in this tier's variation matrix.

term.description: Vocabulary term used at this tier.

documentation_sources.description: File paths of documentation the enricher consulted to ground its content.
